SwetrixProjectId.description: Swetrix project ID from the CE dashboard. Tracking is disabled when this is empty.

SwetrixApiUrl.description: Swetrix log API URL (init apiURL). For CE use {BASE_URL}/backend/v1/log. Tracking is disabled when this is empty.

SwetrixScriptUrl.description: URL of the official Swetrix tracker script.

SwetrixDevMode.description: When true, localhost page views are sent to the API (Swetrix init devMode).

SwetrixHonorDNT.description: When true, tracking is disabled for requests that send the DNT (Do Not Track) header.

SwetrixTrackOutboundClicks.description: When true, clicks on external links that are not network domains fire link.outbound.click.

SwetrixTrackNetworkClicks.description: When true, clicks on links whose host is in $wgSwetrixNetworkDomains fire link.network.click.

SwetrixNetworkDomains.description: Hostnames treated as the wiki network (e.g. sister sites). Matching hosts and their subdomains fire link.network.click instead of link.outbound.click.
